name: HOBOrganismTaxonomy
title: HOB Organism Taxonomy - SNOMED CT Supplement
description: SNOMED CT code system supplement carrying the NHSN HOB organism-taxonomy rollup and classification properties. Generated from the OrganismTaxonomy expression in the HOBOrganismTaxonomy CQL library (the source is a work-in-progress alphabetical fragment, so this supplement is incomplete). The source columns roll_up_genus_level / roll_up_species_level are omitted because they are fully implied by the presence of the roll-up-genus / roll-up-species properties, and the always-null 'L' column is omitted. Genus/species preferred terms are carried as the display of each Coding-valued property.

property.description: Genus-level SNOMED CT concept this organism rolls up to (roll_up_genus_conceptid / roll_up_genus_name).
Species-level SNOMED CT concept this organism rolls up to (roll_up_species_conceptid / roll_up_species_name). Absent for genus-level or higher concepts.
NHSN classification: organism is community-associated (source nhsn_community_associated, 1=true).
NHSN classification: organism is a common skin commensal (source nhsn_skin_commensal, 1=true).
SNOMED status flag as recorded in the source taxonomy ('0'/'1'). Exact semantics to be confirmed (likely active=1).
